summary: Strong product presentation: each LED screen has a photo, size, traffic flow and estimated views, inside a tight, consistent design. It loses trust on a headline number ('1M+ Daily Views' while the largest screen claims '1M+ monthly impressions'), leaves two 'Coming Soon' placeholders live, gives buyers no rate card or availability, and shares the agency site's SEO problems.

findings.title: '1M+ Daily Views' contradicts the per-screen figures
findings.why: Media buyers check numbers; one inflated headline taints the whole rate conversation.
findings.fix: Change the hero to the network monthly total (sum of the screens, about 2.8M+) and add 'Estimated from RTA traffic counts, 2025' or the real source.

findings.title: Screen locations have no pages; site is JS-rendered

evidence.quote: Hatat House, Hormuz Grand Gold, Lulu Zakher Mall... no URLs

findings.fix: Pre-render and create one page per screen (photo, specs, map, availability) plus a /network/ index.

findings.title: Two 'Coming Soon' placeholders are live
